posts.headline: The African Bald Fraud conspiracy didn't just go cold — it's officially closed, and mjwithgoldhoops is running away with this league.
posts.detail: Championshipsovercoochie sits alone at 8-2 with a league-best 1402.42 points-for, and the gap between him and everyone else is growing by the week.

posts.headline: Sixty editions in and the defending champ still can't buy respect from his own scoreboard.
posts.detail: Thicks' Klint's Clipboard is 7-3, but 1092.54 points-for ranks him among the weakest winning records in the league — the ring from his 1-title, 14-14 career keeps cashing checks the stat sheet won't honor.

posts.headline: Chauncey's team has stopped being a joke and started being a cautionary tale.
posts.detail: At 2-8 with a career 12th-place average finish and a 4-10 all-time record, talentedtenthh isn't underachieving anymore — this IS the achievement, and it's exactly what the name predicted.

posts.headline: Big Head's title defense has gone from flatlined to forgotten, and nobody's even checking the pulse anymore.
posts.detail: Sasinci is stuck at 4-6, a far cry from the championship pedigree that once earned him a ring — a 13-15 career record now says the magic was a one-time fluke.

posts.headline: Say what you want about the nickname, but Bubble Guts is quietly building the best resume in the Titty Committee.
posts.detail: Peacemakers 🙏 are 8-2 with 1382.02 points-for, trailing only Championshipsovercoochie in the entire league — a massive leap from his 15-13, 4th-place-average career floor.
